descriptions.job-0lrlknt:
Talent Acquisition Specialist
Hybrid in Southfield, MI, 3 days per week onsite

About Proof
We’re Proof, a high-growth company in the legal tech industry, founded in 2017. We’ve built a best-in-class platform trusted by thousands of law firms across the United States for Service of Process, the formal delivery of legal documents, and E-Filing. We connect law firms with process servers and enable electronic court filing, delivering over 60,000 documents per month through a network of about 2,000 contracted process servers. We’re working to make the legal system more efficient, transparent, and accessible than it’s traditionally been.

About the Role
We’re looking for a Talent Acquisition Specialist to lead high-volume hiring for remote and in-person roles supporting our Operations Hub in Southfield, MI. You’ll build a pipeline by reviewing incoming applicants daily and conducting proactive sourcing, and you’ll own the recruitment process from first outreach through offer. You’ll also support hiring for other roles across the company, such as Sales, Software Engineering, and administrative functions.

What You’ll Do

  • Own full-cycle recruiting for Operations Hub roles, from sourcing and screening through extending offers.
  • Run high-volume hiring that keeps pace with business demand while protecting candidate experience and quality of hire.
  • Build talent pipelines for current and future needs through job boards, referrals, local partnerships, and recruiting events, and build talent maps of the legal and service of process industries for harder-to-fill and leadership roles.
  • Partner with external agency partners on hard-to-fill roles, managing handoffs, candidate quality, and cost.
  • Partner with hiring managers on role needs, interview process, and selection, coaching them on effective interviewing where needed.
  • Manage requisitions, candidates, and pipeline data in Greenhouse, and report on key metrics such as time to fill, pipeline health, and source of hire, with actionable insights.
  • Contribute ideas to improve our recruiting processes and represent Proof’s culture to candidates.
  • Handle confidential information with discretion.

What You’ll Bring

  • 3+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, including proactive sourcing, high-volume hiring for operations roles, and extending offers, with experience across exempt and non-exempt roles.
  • Experience with job boards such as LinkedIn and Indeed, and proficiency with Greenhouse and LinkedIn Recruiter.
  • Experience recruiting in or sourcing from the legal and service of process industries, or a proven ability to map and source talent in specialized industries.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to manage many open roles at once.
  • Ability to work onsite in Southfield, MI a minimum of three days per week.
  • Bonus points: experience in a call center or service center environment, recruiting for operations leadership roles, familiarity with AI-powered sourcing tools, or an existing network in the Detroit area.

Compensation

  • Full-time, salaried position
  • Compensation: $75,000-$85,000 base salary
  • Eligible to participate in company bonus plan

Benefits

  • Medical, dental, vision, and disability insurance, and 401(k) available
  • Paid time off and paid holidays
  • Equipment provided
  • Two remote/work-from-home days per week

E-Verify

This company participates in E-Verify, for more information view the Participation and Right to Work Posters.
descriptions.job-0r1irdl:
About Stripe and Bridge

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

Bridge is a subsidiary of Stripe that is building a new payments platform powered by stablecoins to make global money movement simpler, faster, and more accessible. Through our APIs, businesses can send and receive funds across borders, give customers access to dollars through virtual accounts, and disburse USD globally.

About the team

We are seeking a Senior Treasury Specialist to oversee capital adequacy, liquidity stress testing, financial risk management, and contingency funding planning for Bridge National Trust Bank (BNTB)'s Treasury and Reserve Operations. Issuing digital assets that are fully backed by reserves raises new questions for a regulated bank: how much capital and liquidity it needs, how it holds up under stress, and how it shows management, the Board, and regulators that it is safe and sound.

What you'll do

In this role, you will support Stripe’s proposed national trust bank, Bridge National Trust Bank (BNTB), currently in formation and subject to full regulatory approval by the OCC. You will build and run the bank's capital, liquidity, and financial risk management framework and the governance around it. That includes the analysis, monitoring, policies, and reporting that let the bank grow safely as regulatory requirements for stablecoin issuers continue to evolve.

You will partner closely with the BNTB Treasury and Reserve Operations team, the broader Bridge and Stripe treasury team, risk, compliance, finance, accounting, regulatory reporting, product, data science, and engineering. In the near term, you will help design the frameworks and put the first cycles into practice. As the bank scales, you will turn them into repeatable, automated processes.

Responsibilities

  • Own capital planning and the ongoing assessment of the bank's capital adequacy
  • Own and report on capital, liquidity, and financial risk metrics against risk appetite and limits; escalate breaches and emerging trends
  • Design and run liquidity and capital stress testing, and turn the results into recommendations for funding and capital strategy
  • Own contingency funding planning, including annual testing and tracking remediation to closure
  • Maintain treasury risk policies and procedures, and prepare management and Board reporting
  • Provide risk oversight of reserve and investment activity (counterparty, concentration, liquidity and interest rate risk); partner with product, data science, and engineering to automate monitoring and reporting
  • Coordinate with the broader Stripe treasury team on capital management initiatives including consolidated capital planning, infrastructure and methodology development and governance frameworks

Who you are

You are a builder - we are building a new OCC  chartered bank and we are looking for folks who thrive in a fast-paced, growing environment. This means one day you may be working on a stress testing methodology and the next day speaking with engineers about a critical liquidity concept to be incorporated into systems. You will thrive here if that energizes you, if you take ownership of whatever is needed, and if you bring the same rigor to a stress test assumption as you do to a Board memo. You combine the discipline of a risk manager with the instincts of a builder, and you can explain capital and liquidity concepts clearly to treasury, product, and engineering partners.

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 7-10 years of experience in treasury, capital planning, liquidity risk, stress testing, or financial risk management
  • Hands-on experience building or running capital or liquidity frameworks at a regulated US financial institution
  • Experience writing and presenting on policies, procedures, or management and Board materials
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to assess incomplete information and make sound recommendations
  • Strong experience using AI tools to build, automate, and improve workflows and data analytics
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to build relationships across treasury, risk, finance, product, and engineering
  • Based in or willing to relocate to New York

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience at a bank regulated by the OCC or Federal Reserve
  • Interest rate or fixed-income risk analytics
  • Experience with SQL, Python, or equivalent for analysis and reporting
  • Interest in digital assets or stablecoins

Robinhood is looking for a Senior Client Platform Engineer to join our Enterprise Technology organization. The Client Platform Engineering team builds and scales the systems that manage, secure, and support employee devices across Robinhood. We're focused on pushing the boundaries of traditional endpoint management through automation, AI-powered tooling, and modern engineering practices to create a more secure, efficient, and seamless employee experience.

In this role, you'll work at the intersection of endpoint engineering, software development, and AI-driven automation. You'll build and maintain the infrastructure, tooling, and automation that power device management across our global workforce, with a strong focus on macOS environments. From developing custom tools and debugging complex systems to leveraging AI to accelerate engineering workflows, you'll have the opportunity to solve challenging technical problems and drive meaningful improvements at scale. You'll join a lean, highly technical team where creativity, resourcefulness, and engineering ownership are essential. You'll partner closely with Security, IT, and Engineering to develop scalable solutions, improve platform reliability, and help shape the future of endpoint management at Robinhood.

This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA office, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. 

What you’ll do

  • Design, build, and scale endpoint management infrastructure supporting macOS, Windows, and mobile devices across Robinhood's global workforce.
  • Develop and maintain custom automation, internal tooling, and configuration management solutions using technologies such as Munki, SaltStack, and MDM platforms.
  • Write, debug, and optimize code to improve device provisioning, configuration management, software deployment, and ongoing endpoint operations.
  • Leverage AI-powered development tools to accelerate automation and engineering workflows, while critically evaluating, troubleshooting, and refining AI-generated code.
  • Build and improve automated testing, deployment pipelines, and workflows to increase the reliability, scalability, and efficiency of endpoint management systems.
  • Monitor device management infrastructure, investigate logs, troubleshoot complex technical issues, and drive root cause analysis and long-term solutions.
  • Identify opportunities to eliminate repetitive manual processes through creative engineering solutions and scalable automation.
  • Partner with Security, IT, and Engineering teams to strengthen endpoint security, improve platform reliability, and support evolving business needs.
  • Provide technical guidance and support to other team members, sharing engineering best practices and helping drive continuous improvement.

What you bring

  • 5+ years of relevant experience in Client Platform Engineering, Endpoint Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a similar technical role supporting enterprise device environments.
  • Strong hands-on experience managing enterprise endpoint environments, particularly macOS, using tools such as Munki, SaltStack, and FleetDM solutions.
  • Strong programming and scripting skills, ideally in Python, with demonstrated experience building, maintaining, and debugging custom tools and automation.
  • Proven experience developing automation solutions for device provisioning, configuration management, software deployment, or endpoint lifecycle management.
  • Experience managing and troubleshooting endpoint infrastructure at scale, ideally supporting thousands of devices across multiple operating systems.
  • Ability to understand, troubleshoot, and improve complex codebases, including code generated with AI-powered development tools.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools and an interest in applying emerging technologies to improve engineering productivity and infrastructure automation.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, with the creativity and resourcefulness to develop practical solutions to complex technical challenges.
  • Experience working across multiple endpoint platforms, with a strong preference for macOS expertise.
  • An engineering-first mindset, strong technical ownership, and a passion for building scalable systems rather than relying on manual processes.

What we offer

  • Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching.
  • Top Tier benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents.

About Bitdeer

Bitdeer is a world-leading technology company for Bitcoin mining and AI cloud.

Bitdeer is committed to providing comprehensive Bitcoin mining solutions for its customers. Apart from designing industry-leading ASIC chips and manufacturing mining rigs, the Group handles complex processes involved in computing across the value chain. This includes equipment procurement, transport logistics, datacenter design and construction, equipment management, and network and facility operations. Bitdeer also offers advanced cloud capabilities to customers with a high demand for artificial intelligence.

Headquartered in Singapore, Bitdeer operates globally with a diversified 3 GW energy portfolio, and deploys Bitcoin mining and HPC datacenters in the United States, Bhutan, Norway, Canada, Malaysia, and Ethiopia.

We are seeking

We are seeking an AI Datacenter Construction Manager to lead on-site delivery of Bitdeer’s AI data center builds. Reporting to the VP, Data Center Construction, you will be Bitdeer’s senior representative on site, accountable for safety, schedule, quality, and cost from mobilization through energization, commissioning, and turnover.

You will manage the general contractor and trade partners day to day, coordinate discipline leads, and keep the site moving to plan. The ideal candidate has run large data center or mission-critical sites from the owner’s or general contractor’s side.

Location: Candidates will work on site as needed and should be based in one of the following areas, primarily in Texas and Ohio: Austin, TX; Rockdale, TX; Abilene, TX; Houston, TX; Dallas, TX; Massillon, OH; Clarington, OH; Columbus, OH; Akron, OH; or Pittsburgh, PA.

What you will be responsible for

Site Leadership

  • Owner’s Representative: Act as Bitdeer’s on-site lead and single point of accountability for the build.
  • Contractor Management: Direct the general contractor and trade partners on safety, quality, productivity, and schedule.
  • Daily Coordination: Run site coordination meetings, look-ahead planning, and site logistics.

Schedule & Cost

  • Schedule Delivery: Drive the site schedule and short-interval plans, and flag and recover critical-path slippage.
  • Cost Oversight: Review change requests, quantities, and pay applications with cost and procurement.
  • Progress Reporting: Report progress, risks, and issues to the VP, Data Center Construction and the TPM.

Safety & Quality

  • Site Safety: Enforce site safety plans with the EHS Manager and lead by example in the field.
  • Quality Control: Verify work against drawings and specifications with the QA/QC Manager.

Interfaces & Turnover

  • Discipline Coordination: Coordinate civil, electrical/HV, mechanical, fiber, and ELV scopes on site.

How you will stand out

  • Experience: 10+ years in construction management, including 5+ years leading data center or mission-critical sites.
  • Project Scale: Experience delivering large, fast-track builds with multiple concurrent trades.
  • Technical Breadth: Working knowledge of civil, structural, MEP, and commissioning on data center projects.
  • Field Leadership: Proven ability to manage general contractors and trade partners on site.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Certifications: Professional certifications such as OSHA 30-Hour, PMP, or CCM.
  • Site-Based Work: Willingness to be based on site and to travel to or relocate to active project locations.
  • Field Leadership: Earns respect from contractors and crews and leads from the front.
  • Decisiveness: Makes sound calls quickly when field conditions change.
  • Communication: Keeps leadership informed with clear, timely updates.
  • Accountability: Owns the outcome of the site end to end.

What you will experience working with us

  • A culture that values authenticity and diverse perspectives.
  • An inclusive, respectful environment with open workspaces and an energetic, start-up spirit.

  • Personal accountability, autonomy, rapid growth, and learning opportunities.

descriptions.job-1dp3s9l:
LOCATION: Remote anywhere in Canada

About Proof

Proof is the service-of-process marketplace modernizing how legal documents move through the real world. 10,000 law firms, from small practices to the AmLaw 100, trust us with documents that have legal consequences: a serve has to reach the right person, at the right address, under the right rules, with a court-ready affidavit proving what happened.

We're one of the fastest-growing tech enabled services companies in the U.S., and legal tech is one of the most exciting places to build software right now. We're also still early enough that you'll help shape the culture, not just inherit it. Expect real autonomy, the latest AI tools on a modern stack, plus engineers and designers who care about craft as much as you do.

The role

Due process starts at a door. Before a lawsuit can move forward, the person being sued has to be properly notified, and for thousands of cases every day, that happens through a process server using our mobile app. It's one of the most critical steps in the litigation system.

As a Product Manager on the Server Experience and Fulfilment team, you'll own the product experience that helps those servers get it right and on time, from understanding requirements and planning attempts to capturing reliable evidence of service. Your goal is to make that work easier for servers, more predictable for the law firms relying on it, and more profitable for our marketplace overall.

What you'll own

  • Planning and attempts. How servers plan their day, sequence attempts, work high-volume addresses, and see which jobs are at risk before a deadline passes.
  • Job requirements. Helping servers act on each job's legal requirements at the right moment, across states and counties.
  • Evidence of service. The capture and verification behind every attempt: location, time, photos, eligibility checks. Raise the quality bar without slowing servers down, even with no signal.
  • Fewer handoffs. Deciding what belongs in the app, what AI and automation can handle, and what still needs one of our service specialists.
  • Efficient dispatch. How job offers get packaged, priced, and distributed to servers, and the product systems behind server pay.

Your team and scope

You're joining an established team that has driven some of Proof's biggest wins over the last two years. It moves quickly, ships with impact, and has built a best-in-class mobile app for process servers.

You'll report to the CPO and, as a hands-on IC, partner with a dedicated engineering squad and our design team on discovery, analysis, and delivery. You're accountable for the squad's multi-quarter roadmap. Day to day, you'll work side by side with a world-class operations team that handles server recruitment, rate negotiation, and risk and compliance, and with four other PMs who lead the law firm experience, platform automation, filing, and integrations.

What success looks like in year one

  • More jobs meet their service deadlines, without more avoidable reattempts.
  • Less avoidable specialist work per job, with service quality continuing to improve.
  • More complete, trustworthy evidence from the field, and fewer downstream corrections caused by missing or incorrect server inputs.
  • Servers find the work easier, and it shows in retention: more of our best servers stay active and take on more jobs.

Who we're hiring

You'll be a strong fit if:

  • You've owned a consequential workflow from identifying the problem through launch and adoption, and can explain what you chose not to build, the tradeoffs you made, and the results.
  • You've built a mobile product people depend on to do their jobs: drivers, couriers, field technicians, inspectors, or similar.
  • You think in systems. You see how a change in the app ripples through dispatch, operations, and the law firm on the other end, and you design automation that holds up as volume grows.
  • You make sure the right decision gets made, even when law firms, servers, and operations want different things and the final call isn't yours.
  • You have strong design instincts: you sketch flows, prototype with AI, and sweat the details of an app people use all day in the field.
  • You do your own discovery and analysis: you watch users do the work, pull your own numbers, and turn both into a clear point of view.

Bonus points if you have:

  • Experience automating customer service or operational workflows.
  • Supply-side marketplace experience: matching, dispatch, pay, or keeping a field workforce engaged.
  • Legal tech or other regulated work where rules change by jurisdiction.
  • Location, identity, or fraud verification in a mobile product.

This probably isn't the right seat if:

  • You'd rather manage PMs than ship product. This is an IC role.
  • You reach for heavy process before understanding the problem.
  • You'd rather hand off customer interviews and the data work than own them.

Why now

Proof is gaining market share quickly, and every new law firm and market puts more demand on the last mile: a process server completing the job in the field. You’ll build on a mobile app rated 4.5 stars on iOS and Android and a recently modernized codebase that lets the team ship fast. The next challenge is helping servers complete more work with less manual coordination, and you'll help shape what comes next.


Benefits:

  • Full-time, salary position
  • Fully remote role, based in Canada
  • Flexible time off and holidays 
  • Equipment provided
  • Comprehensive benefits package, including healthcare, dental, and disability insurance

Compensation:

  • 135,000 - 180,000 CAD based on experience and location. Must be located in Canada
  • Eligible to participate in company bonus plan
descriptions.job-18ongd5:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Platform Sales team is a highly consultative, enterprise sales team that is responsible for some of Stripe’s largest and fastest growing partners. Stripe helps software platforms offer more value to their customers by embedding Stripe’s powerful payments technology into their solution. As a Platform Sales Manager, you will play a critical role on our go-to-market leadership bench - leading a team of AEs to make payments-as-a-service a competitive advantage for high-growth organizations in the UK.

What you’ll do

  • Drive sales growth through successful leadership, organizational planning, customer service and outstanding execution 
  • Oversee the expansion of Stripe’s footprint with global SaaS platforms in the UK
  • Make hiring decisions, honing our ideal candidate profile and onboarding strategy
  • Create structure and focus for GTM ideas and product sales campaigns that the product team is exploring. Drive execution and measurement. Analyze results and make recommendations for action in a timely manner.
  • Define key sales support mechanisms, processes, and programs to meet the rapid growth of the business and achieve revenue attainment and market development objectives
  • Build a world-class organization and write the playbook for the era of monetizing payments on platform

Responsibilities

  • Lead a team of sophisticated Existing Business, Platform AEs focused on expanding our global footprint with enterprise SaaS platforms in the UK
  • Drive deal strategy and partner across the business to ensure healthy pipeline, funnel conversion, win rate, and margin preservation across the portfolio
  • Effectively work cross-functionally across the organization to shape Stripe's product roadmap and drive best practices on selling and forecasting
  • Engage with the largest strategic opportunities, leading executive relationships 
  • Being accountable for delivering revenue growth

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 8-10+ years of relevant closing sales experience with enterprise customers/large users
  • 5+ years of people management experience
  • Ability to hire, coach, and motivate a high-performance sales team
  • Ability to articulate complex, technical concepts and translate them into business-relevant terms
  • Demonstrated quantitative and analytical skills

Preferred qualifications 

  • Thrives in fast-paced settings with a high-level of autonomy and can create clarity and structure 
  • A knack for working well with a wide range of stakeholders, both internally and externally
  • Experience scoping and managing strategic projects with input from cross-functional teams
  • Prior experience in financial services, the payments industry, or with the card networks
descriptions.job-1hyedll:
Great stories start with extraordinary people.

We’re bringing together exceptional creative talent to tell the stories of people shaping the future. Work alongside people who raise your standards, champion your ideas, and give you room to do the best work of your career.

Story inspires science. Science makes story real.

Your Story

We're looking for a Head of Production to lead and build the production operation at Story.

Story produces high-end commercial and branded content for some of the world's most ambitious companies, alongside a growing slate of original scripted fiction and nonfiction projects. You'll oversee production across both sides of the business, from commercial campaigns and documentaries to original films and series.

You know how to make ambitious work happen. You've produced everything from large-scale commercial shoots to scrappy, independent productions, and you know how to get exceptional results regardless of the budget.

You're relentless, resourceful, and don't take no for an answer. When a location falls through, a budget gets cut, or a timeline seems impossible, you're the person who finds a way forward.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You'll lead our producers, build exceptional crews, oversee budgets, and work closely with our creative team to bring ambitious ideas to life. We need someone who can build a world-class production operation while still being willing to roll up their sleeves and personally tackle the hardest challenges.

What You'll Own

  • Lead production at Story. Oversee our commercial productions, ensuring projects deliver exceptional work on time and on budget.

  • Build and lead the team. Hire, mentor, and manage producers and production staff. Establish a culture of ownership, resourcefulness, and high standards.

  • Make the impossible happen. Find creative solutions to difficult production challenges. Open doors, push through obstacles, and figure out how to accomplish things others might consider impossible.

  • Manage multiple productions. Balance competing schedules, budgets, and resources across several projects running simultaneously. Know where things stand and where your attention is needed.

  • Own production budgets. Oversee budgeting, cost control, vendor negotiations, and profitability across projects. Know where to invest and where to get creative.

  • Build our production network. Develop relationships with exceptional crew, vendors, locations, and production partners across the country and internationally.

  • Scale our production capabilities. Build systems, workflows, and processes that allow Story to take on more ambitious work without sacrificing quality or efficiency.

  • Partner with creative leadership. Work closely with directors, cinematographers, writers, and the creative team to translate ambitious concepts into executable production plans.

  • Get hands-on. Step in to personally lead complex shoots, solve critical problems, and support the team wherever you're needed.

You're the Right Person If

  • You have extensive experience producing high-end commercials, branded content, documentaries, or scripted film and television productions, including experience leading teams.

  • You understand the different demands of client-driven commercial work and original film and television production.

  • You've managed both large-budget productions and lean, independent shoots. You know how to succeed in both environments.

  • You're exceptionally resourceful. When someone tells you something can't be done, your first instinct is to figure out how.

  • You've overseen multiple productions simultaneously and know how to prioritize people, budgets, and resources.

  • You're a strong leader who knows how to hire great people, delegate effectively, and hold teams to high standards.

  • You have deep experience managing production budgets, negotiating with vendors, and protecting project profitability.

  • You have a strong network of trusted crew, production partners, and vendors.

  • You're highly organized and know how to build systems that make production more efficient without adding unnecessary bureaucracy.

  • You have strong creative instincts and understand what it takes to make exceptional work.

  • You're calm under pressure, decisive when things go wrong, and willing to take responsibility for the outcome.

  • You're based in the SF Bay Area or willing to relocate.

What Sets You Apart

You're a builder, not just a manager. You want to create a production operation that gets better with every project. You can establish the systems, hire the right people, and set the standards that make great work repeatable.

You're relentlessly resourceful. You've made ambitious work happen with limited time, money, and resources. You know who to call, how to negotiate, and when to find a completely different approach.

You can think big and operate small. You're comfortable leading a major commercial production, but you're equally capable of assembling a small crew and making something exceptional happen in a matter of days.

You have great taste. You understand what separates good work from extraordinary work. You protect the creative vision while finding practical ways to execute it.

You lead from the front. You don't just oversee spreadsheets and schedules. You get involved, solve problems, support your producers, and take pride in everything Story puts into the world.

Compensation

The base salary range for this role is $171,000 – $256,000. Your final offer will depend on your experience, skills and level.

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The UI Platform team, known as Sail, builds the foundations that support Stripe’s Dashboard and many of Stripe’s other user interfaces. The Sail UI team owns Stripe’s design system, helping Stripe engineers create consistent, accessible, performant, and high-quality experiences at scale.

We build and maintain reusable components, design tokens, theming capabilities, documentation, and developer tooling used by engineers and designers across Stripe. We are currently focused on two major projects. First, we are building Sail for Agents: the generation infrastructure, documentation systems, agent integrations, and automated quality checks that help AI coding agents build high-quality Stripe interfaces safely and consistently at scale. Second, we are evolving the visual language of the Dashboard, one of Stripe’s largest UI surfaces, while modernizing its underlying codebase.

What you’ll do

As a Frontend Engineer on the Sail UI team, you’ll help build and evolve Stripe’s design system and the tools that enable engineers and AI coding agents to create high-quality user interfaces. You’ll independently drive frontend projects from problem definition through rollout, working closely with designers, product engineers, and other Sail engineers. Your work will range from reusable components, themes, and documentation to agentic tooling, automated quality checks, and modernizing the foundations of Stripe’s Dashboard.

Responsibilities

  • Take end-to-end ownership of software projects, independently scoping problems and carrying solutions through design, implementation, testing, and rollout
  • Build and maintain accessible, performant, and well-tested components, themes, and frontend APIs used across Stripe
  • Build tooling, documentation, and automated quality checks that help engineers and AI coding agents use Sail effectively and meet Stripe’s UI quality bar
  • Partner with product designers and engineers to understand their needs and turn recurring UI patterns into reusable design-system capabilities
  • Help evolve the visual language of Stripe’s Dashboard while modernizing its underlying codebase and migrating legacy UI patterns
  • Improve the accessibility, internationalization, observability, performance, reliability, and developer experience of the design system
  • Contribute thoughtful code reviews, technical discussions, and documentation that improve the quality of the team’s work

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • Fluency in using AI-assisted and agentic development tools as part of day-to-day software engineering, including critically reviewing, validating, and improving generated code
  • 2+ years of professional frontend engineering experience, or equivalent practical experience, building, shipping, and debugging web applications
  • Strong knowledge of modern frontend technologies and frameworks, including browser fundamentals, responsive design, and accessibility
  • Ability to independently scope and deliver open-ended frontend projects, making practical technical and product tradeoffs with limited oversight
  • Strong problem-solving and debugging skills, with attention to testing, maintainability, and the quality of the resulting user experience
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with designers, product engineers, and other partners

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience working on a design system, frontend platform, or shared component library
  • Experience with developer tooling such as build tools, package managers, codemods, lint rules, or large monorepos

  • Experience using documentation, developer feedback, or adoption data to improve a developer-facing product
